name: Handcrafted Collage
description: Cut and pasted by hand: uneven corners, cards stitched round in a dashed line, a soft small offset like a pasted sheet, ink outlines on controls, chunky dotted rules, editorial density, no motion, and a paper-fiber texture on the shared surfaces.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's collage recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.
In forced colors, the material is a solid surface, and shadows and texture drop.
caveats: A decorative gradient texture sits behind surfaces.

tokens.texture: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 3px, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-border-subtle) 35%, transparent) 3px 4px)
